_about: E129: UniMate moves on Cadet's own skeleton (tools/unimate_moves.py; the bow from the Studio's Moves from words panel). Aberrations from work/cadet/qa/aberrations.json (DQS, every frame), the build of 2026-10-02; foot slip from blender/foot_audit.py (worse foot, m/s): before = the moves as first generated, planting switched off (2026-09-30), after = with the toe bone recovered and every vertex of the shoe planted (E130, 2026-10-02). Times measured 2026-09-30 on this Mac (M5, 24 GB).

moves.salute: An object stands at attention and salutes with its right hand raised to its forehead.
moves.ready: An object drops into a ready combat stance with both fists raised and looks left and right.
moves.fist_pump: An object pumps its right fist in the air in celebration.
moves.look_around: An object looks to the left and then to the right.
